newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Soros optimistic on Bulgarian economic recovery.
newsitem.headline: Soros optimistic on Bulgarian economic recovery.

text.p: International financier and philanthropist George Soros said on Friday he was optimistic on Bulgaria's economic recovery, provided reform policies were applied consistently.
"I am very optimistic about the changes that have taken place. The country has gone through a horrendous economic breakdown," Soros told reporters after meeting President Petar Stoyanov.
"I am confident that with new consistent economic reform policies improvement will become visible in a foreseeable future," he added.
The local branch of Soros' Open Society International humanitarian foundation, has invested some $38 million in Bulgaria since its creation in 1990.
Soros said the foundation was considering ways to provide loans to small private businesses in a bid to stimulate the crisis-ridden economy.
